children: 对于人名，凡存在通行的英文形式者，我均采用英文形式；没有的，则采用拉丁化形式。阿拉伯人名与术语的转写，依据《伊斯兰百科全书》（
）所用转写方案的一个略加简化的版本。希腊地名以及希腊的头衔、品级与官职，我保留其希腊语转写形式。希腊语、拉丁语及其他语言中的专门术语、品级与头衔，在书末的词汇表中加以解释。

I have used standard English forms for personal names, where they exist; and where not, Latinized versions. Transliterations of Arabic names and terms are according to a slightly simplified version of that employed in the

. I have left Greek place names and Greek titles, ranks, and offices in their transliterated Greek form. Greek, Latin and other technical terms, ranks, and titles are elucidated in a glossary at the end of the volume.
